caption: Put any item in each of the 2 item frames; a frame turns through 8 positions, one right-click each. The 1 dial hang on the front (west) face; the code frames hang on the back (east) face, facing away, so a player at the dials sees only the dials and the output, never the code. Set the code from behind by turning the code frames, then turn the dials to match them: the torch at the north end, under the bus, lights (open) only when every dial shows the same position as its code frame, and never for a moment while you turn. Wire a piston door or an iron door to that torch. Inside, per dial: a comparator behind the code frame's block reads the code and powers a block beside the code dust, so the dust carries the code at full value; the dial's comparator passes the dial's value only if it is at least the code (else a torch under its dust lights), and a second comparator passes the code only if it is at least the dial's value (else a torch on its block lights). One dust line under all the torches joins every mismatch into the block under its north end, which turns the output torch off (opens within 6 ticks, closes within 8). A dial takes 3 rows; dials pair up back to back, with one empty row between pairs.
